Kuvitus: maantien liikennevalot ovat juu: Illustration: the traffic lights on a country road have just turned green, and two identical trucks have set off from side-by-side lanes. The nearer truck is fully loaded with logs and has only just crossed the stop line. The empty truck farther away is already clearly ahead. Forest and fields are in the background.
Kaksi tilannetta. Vasemmalla laatikko le: Two situations. On the left a box rests on the floor. In its free-body diagram the box is a rectangle: the weight G points down from the centre and the normal force N from the floor points up from the bottom surface, equally long. On the right the same box is pulled horizontally to the right by a rope, and in the situation picture an orange acceleration arrow points to the right above the box. Its free-body diagram has the weight and the normal force equally long, the tension T of the rope to the right, and the friction force from the floor to the left from the back corner of the bottom surface, one third of the length of the tension. Separately there is a green hollow arrow, the net force, to the right: the difference between the tension and the friction. The arrows are to scale.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaaka-akselilla k: Graph to scale: the horizontal axis shows the net force in newtons from 0 to 3, and the vertical axis shows the acceleration from 0 to 6 metres per second squared. Two straight lines through the origin, each with three points. For a mass of 0.50 kilograms the points are 1 N and 2, 2 N and 4, and 3 N and 6. For a mass of 1.0 kilogram the points are 1 N and 1, 2 N and 2, and 3 N and 3. Dashed lines show that at a net force of 2 N the acceleration of the lighter cart is 4 and that of the heavier cart is 2.
Neljä tilannetta, joissa nosturin köysi: Four situations in which the rope of a crane holds a crate. Each has the situation picture on the left and the free-body diagram of the crate on the right, where the crate is a rectangle: the weight G points down from the centre and the tension T of the rope points up from the top surface. Next to the free-body diagram there is a blue velocity arrow and an orange acceleration arrow when they are not zero. At the top left the crate is at rest, v and a are zero and the arrows T and G are equally long. At the top right the crate rises at constant velocity: the velocity is up, a is zero and the arrows are equally long. At the bottom left the crate rises while speeding up: the velocity and the acceleration are up, and T is longer than G. At the bottom right the crate rises while slowing down: the velocity is up but the acceleration is down, and T is shorter than G.
Betonielementin voimakuvio, elementti su: Free-body diagram of the concrete slab, the slab as a rectangle. The tension T of the rope starts from the top surface and points up, and the weight G starts from the centre and points down. The arrow T is a little longer than the arrow G. Separately on the right there is an orange acceleration arrow pointing up. On the right there is also a small arrow y pointing up: the positive direction is up. On the left is the situation picture: the hook of a crane lifts the concrete slab on a rope.

On the right the free-body diagram of the crate, the crate as a rectangle: the tension T of the rope points up from the top surface and the weight G points down from the centre. The arrow T is longer than the arrow G.

Mallikuvio: kirjaa työnnetään pöydällä v: Model diagram: a book is pushed horizontally to the right on a table, and it accelerates. The diagram contains only the book, as a rectangle. From the centre the weight G points down, and from the bottom surface the normal force N from the table points up, equally long. The pushing force F of the hand points to the right and ends at the left side of the book. The friction force from the table starts from the back corner of the bottom surface and points to the left, and it is shorter than the pushing force. Separately there is an orange acceleration arrow to the right.
